context: Tests whether the agent produces a correctly structured tasks.md file inside the spec directory, following the prescribed template format with all required fields for each task and a progress log section.

checklist.name: Top-level title
checklist.description: tasks.md starts with a `# Tasks: ...` heading (H1 with 'Tasks:' prefix)

checklist.name: Tasks section heading
checklist.description: tasks.md contains a `## Tasks` section heading

checklist.name: Numbered task headings
checklist.description: Each individual task uses a `### N. Task name` heading (H3 with a number prefix)

checklist.name: Status: Pending on all tasks
checklist.description: Every task has a `**Status**: Pending` field (all tasks start as Pending, none are pre-marked In Progress or Done)

checklist.name: Goal field on each task
checklist.description: Every task has a `**Goal**:` field describing what the task achieves

checklist.name: Boundary field on each task
checklist.description: Every task has a `**Boundary**:` field listing the files or modules the task touches

checklist.name: Done when field on each task
checklist.description: Every task has a `**Done when**:` field with observable completion criteria

checklist.name: Single-concern tasks
checklist.description: Tasks are scoped to a single concern (e.g., separate tasks for DB schema, token generation, email sending, reset form) rather than one monolithic task covering the entire feature

checklist.name: Progress Log section
checklist.description: tasks.md ends with a `## Progress Log` section
